outcome: HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HCV, and anti-HIV seroprevalence
cohort: 810 Syrian refugee pregnant women and 810 Turkish pregnant women
finding: Syrian refugee pregnant women had higher rates of adolescent pregnancy, lower gestational age and birth weight, and different seroprevalence profiles for several infections compared to Turkish pregnant women.
mod_finding: Syrian refugee women had higher rates of normal vaginal birth compared to Turkish women.
